name: Gideon Crowe
source_profile: ● Gideon Crowe (LE) is the agency's chief frontier field captain, responsible for organizing armed posses, apprehending dangerous fugitives, and protecting company property. Crowe is ruthlessly efficient and has little hesitation about employing threats, coercion, or excessive force when he believes the situation warrants it.
source_reference: Handbook v0.4, pp. 152–161; Legendarium v1.0, pp. 148–157; project NPC index; Legendarium v1.0, p. 43 (source excerpt; may be partial)
